facts.material: plastic helmet shell with auto-darkening welding filter, face seal, air hose and powered air purifying blower unit with filters (assumed)
facts.function: protects the welder's face and eyes and supplies filtered air to breathe
facts.form: welding helmet combined with a powered air purifying respirator, imported together as one system

gri_path: GRI 1: prima facie classifiable in 6506.10 (safety headgear), 9004.90 (protective eye goggles) and 9020 (other breathing appliances); chapter 65 note 1 does not exclude it
GRI 3(a): each heading describes only part of the composite good, so the headings are regarded as equally specific

GRI 3(b): the powered respirator (blower, filter, air delivery to the headtop) gives the essential character by value, complexity and its role in protecting the user from welding fumes, so heading 9020
GRI 6: 9020.00.60.00 other breathing appliances and gas masks (not underwater breathing devices)

rejected_alternatives.reason: safety headgear heading covers only the helmet shell; the powered respirator supplies the essential character (GRI 3(b))
the auto-darkening filter protects the eyes but does not give the article its essential character
parts and accessories line; the system is a complete breathing appliance

missing_facts: Is the powered blower/respirator unit imported with the helmet, or is the helmet imported alone with only an air-delivery fitting (then 6506.10 or 9020.00.90 as a part)?
classification.rationale: The Speedglas helmet with respirator combines safety headgear, an eye-protective filter and a powered air purifying respirator, so it is a composite good classified by GRI 3(b). The respirator function gives the essential character, placing it in heading 9020 as another breathing appliance, 9020.00.60.00. NY I80102 (in force) confirms that air purifying respirators with replaceable filters fall in 9020.00.6000; no ruling on this exact combined helmet was found.
